F.label: F01.1
F.text: To make autopilot flight targets settable by the pilot (commit numeric altitude/heading/speed setpoints).

F.label: F02.1
F.text: To make the pilot aware that the autopilot has reached the commanded target.

F.label: F03.1
F.text: Engage an autopilot mode: transition the aircraft from manual to autopilot-controlled flight by committing it to a selected automation behaviour, with a defined autopilot mode becoming active.

F.label: F04.1
F.text: To terminate an active autopilot mode.

F.label: F04.2
F.text: To enable pilot selection of manual flight control.

F.label: F05.1
F.text: Submit structured intelligence reports to C2.

F.label: F06.1
F.text: Convey the order's content to the pilot (comprehension of what is tasked): the pilot understands what the order is — type, target/area, parameters — not just that one arrived, via a sustained readable/legible presentation the pilot can parse and reference.

Be.label: Be01.1.1
Be.text: Direct value entry via WAD field (Touch keypad / Keyboard UCP or rotary).

Be.label: Be01.1.2
Be.text: Increment/step value entry via WAD field (Touch keypad / Keyboard UCP or rotary).

Be.label: Be01.1.3
Be.text: Preset pick value entry via WAD field (Touch keypad / Keyboard UCP or rotary).

Be.label: Be02.1.1
Be.text: Discrete event announcement. Screen shows Target field + real-time Current field, awareness via convergence. Audio-out gives a one-shot callout at transition.

Be.label: Be03.1.1
Be.text: Direct mode selection (flat, one-shot): each autopilot mode is individually addressable and committing to one is the engagement. Touch: tap the target mode on the WAD Autopilot Mode Panel. Keyboard: a dedicated bezel OSS per mode, or rotary-step to a mode plus a commit button. One deliberate actuation engages the selected mode; full task completable via Touch alone, Keyboard alone, or any mix.

Be.label: Be04.1.1
Be.text: Deactivate-by-re-press: the pilot re-presses the currently-active autopilot mode control to deselect it; the HMI forwards the manual-control command and the mode indicator clears on aircraft confirmation. Realized via Touch alone (re-tap active mode on WAD), Keyboard alone (re-press active-mode OSS), or mixed. Realizes F-04.1 (terminate an active autopilot mode).

Be.label: Be04.2.1
Be.text: One-shot disengage: the pilot issues a single discrete action on a dedicated MANUAL affordance to hand control back to manual flight. Realized via Touch alone (tap MANUAL button), Keyboard alone (press MANUAL OSS), or mixed. Realizes F-04.2 (enable pilot selection of manual flight control).

Be.label: Be05.1.1
Be.text: Press-and-hold on Map screen opens an option ring at that location; pilot selects a preset intelligence marker from the ring; selection commits the marker at that map location and sends it to C2. Touch alone (hold on WAD + tap) / Keyboard alone (bezel rotary step + OSS confirm) / mixed.

Be.label: Be06.1.1
Be.text: Full parallel presentation**: on order arrival, complete order content rendered persistently on Screen AND spoken in full via templated TTS; either channel alone conveys the complete order.

S.label: S01.1.1.1
S.text: Autopilot Setpoint Panel (WAD overlay, shared home).

S.label: S01.1.1.2
S.text: Numeric keypad (Touch).

S.label: S01.1.1.3
S.text: Step controls (Touch).

S.label: S01.1.1.4
S.text: Preset list (Touch).

S.label: S01.1.1.5
S.text: Bezel rotary+OSS (Keyboard).

S.label: S01.1.1.6
S.text: UCP alphanumeric (Keyboard).

S.label: S02.1.1.1
S.text: AP Target/Current panel (WAD) — shared with AP-set (1.2.3) and AP-mode/state display.

S.label: S02.1.1.2
S.text: AP audio callout (Audio system) — shared notify channel across other requirements.

S.label: S02.1.1.3
S.text: AP 'condition reached' flag (HUD) — dedicated boolean indication, minimal footprint.

S.label: S03.1.1.1
S.text: Autopilot Mode Panel (WAD): each autopilot mode a directly-tappable on-screen button, one tap engages that mode (Touch path); panel renders active-mode state (shared with R02).

S.label: S03.1.1.2
S.text: Bezel mode OSS: one dedicated on-screen-select switch per autopilot mode, one press engages that mode directly (Keyboard path).

S.label: S04.1.1.1
S.text: Autopilot mode panel (WAD), shared w/ R03; active-mode controls support re-tap-to-deselect. Touch / Be-04.2.

S.label: S04.1.1.2
S.text: Bezel mode buttons (OSS), shared w/ R03; active-mode OSS re-press-to-deselect + dedicated MANUAL button. Keyboard / both Behaviours.

S.label: S04.2.1.1
S.text: Dedicated MANUAL touch button (WAD) on the mode panel, counterpart to bezel MANUAL. Touch / Be-04.1.

S.label: S05.1.1.1
S.text: Map view (WAD) — existing screen, reused as host surface for press-and-hold interaction and marker rendering. Shared with R06/R07 (map-anchored tasks).

S.label: S05.1.1.2
S.text: Option ring — radial menu overlay spawned at the selected map point, listing preset intelligence markers. Shared mechanic pattern with R06/R07; preset content differs per requirement.

S.label: S05.1.1.3
S.text: Preset marker buttons — selectable intel-taxonomy entries within the option ring (e.g. hostile contact, vehicle, structure).

S.label: S05.1.1.4
S.text: Marker glyph layer — WAD overlay rendering committed markers at their map coordinates.

S.label: S05.1.1.5
S.text: Input bindings (redundant): Touch — press-and-hold on WAD + tap to select/commit; Keyboard — bezel rotary to position/step through presets + OSS to open menu/confirm.

S.label: S06.2.1
S.text: Order Content Panel(WAD, Screen): persistent templated full-order display; stacked overlay layer on the R05 Map/task surface. Always-complete Screen path.

S.label: S06.2.2
S.text: Order TTS readout (cockpit audio, Audio-out): templated full-order speech on arrival; reuses R02 shared notify/audio-out channel. Always-complete Audio path.

S.label: S06.2.3
S.text: HUD order flag (HUD, Screen): minimal eyes-out 'new order' indicator pointing to the WAD panel; supplementary, consistent with R02's dedicated HUD flag.
